fruits.extendedStory: Inside this 15th-century house hides a Gothic malt house, where grain was soaked until it sprouted. The story goes that a glass keg on show here travelled all the way to the Vatican, for the Pope. Under the Old Town lies the Historical Underground, with 13 kilometres of passages. Its tour starts here, in an ice house. Melting ice ran down from it to cool the cellars where food was kept.

localizedExtendedStory.de: In diesem Haus aus dem 15. Jahrhundert verbirgt sich eine gotische Mälzerei, in der Getreide eingeweicht wurde, bis es keimte. Man erzählt, ein gläsernes Fässchen, das hier ausgestellt ist, sei bis in den Vatikan gereist, für den Papst. Unter der Altstadt liegt der historische Untergrund, mit 13 Kilometern Gängen. Seine Führung beginnt hier, in einem Eiskeller. Schmelzwasser vom Eis lief von dort hinab und kühlte die Keller, in denen man Lebensmittel lagerte.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Inside this 15th-century house hides a Gothic malt house, where grain was soaked until it sprouted. The story goes that a glass keg on show here travelled all the way to the Vatican, for the Pope. Under the Old Town lies the Historical Underground, with 13 kilometres of passages. Its tour starts here, in an ice house. Melting ice ran down from it to cool the cellars where food was kept.

localizedStory.de: Dieses Haus hatte einst das Braurecht. Im Streifen zwischen den Stadtmauern, wo früher Getreide wuchs, zieht sein Museum heute Hopfen.
localizedStory.en: This house once had the right to brew. In the strip between the town walls, where grain used to grow, its museum now grows hops.

fruits.name: Pivovarské muzeum v Plzni
fruits.story: This house once had the right to brew. In the strip between the town walls, where grain used to grow, its museum now grows hops.

fruits.extendedStory: Locals call it Ošahánek, roughly the little one everyone touches. Many people who are not believers bring it their wishes, the way people once did at wayside crosses and saints. Above you rises the tallest church tower in the Czech Republic, about 102 metres. When it was built, it was the second tallest tower in all of Europe. Two of its bells honour St John and St Mary, and locals call them Jeníček and Mařenka: little John, little Mary.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Die Einheimischen nennen ihn Ošahánek, was so viel heißt wie der kleine Betatschte. Viele, die nicht gläubig sind, bringen ihm ihre Wünsche, so wie man früher zu Wegkreuzen und Heiligenfiguren ging. Über dir ragt der höchste Kirchturm Tschechiens auf, etwa 102 Meter hoch. Als er gebaut wurde, war er der zweithöchste Turm in ganz Europa. Zwei seiner Glocken sind Johannes und Maria geweiht, und man nennt sie Jeníček und Mařenka: Hänschen und Mariechen.
localizedExtendedStory.en: Locals call it Ošahánek, roughly the little one everyone touches. Many people who are not believers bring it their wishes, the way people once did at wayside crosses and saints. Above you rises the tallest church tower in the Czech Republic, about 102 metres. When it was built, it was the second tallest tower in all of Europe. Two of its bells honour St John and St Mary, and locals call them Jeníček and Mařenka: little John, little Mary.

localizedStory.de: Man erzählt, dass der kleine Engel am Gitter der Kathedrale jedem Glück bringt, der ihn berührt, und die Leute stehen dafür Schlange.
localizedStory.en: People say the little angel on the cathedral's grille brings luck to anyone who touches it, and they queue to try.

fruits.name: svatý Bartoloměj
fruits.story: People say the little angel on the cathedral's grille brings luck to anyone who touches it, and they queue to try.

fruits.extendedStory: A plaque inside says the house was built in 1901 to honour the Czech nation. Above the third-floor windows, gold letters spell names like the composer Smetana and the poet Neruda. Much of the house began with gas lamps. But the inventor František Křižík made sure its Great Hall had electric light from the start. People who remembered the writer Karel Klostermann said he sat in the café here, telling stories of his beloved Šumava forest.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Eine Tafel drinnen sagt, das Haus sei 1901 zur Ehre der tschechischen Nation gebaut worden. Über den Fenstern im dritten Stock stehen goldene Namen, etwa der Komponist Smetana und der Dichter Neruda. Ein Großteil des Hauses hatte anfangs Gaslicht. Doch der Erfinder František Křižík sorgte dafür, dass sein Großer Saal von Anfang an elektrisches Licht hatte. Wer Karel Klostermann noch kannte, sagte, der Schriftsteller habe hier im Café gesessen und von seinem geliebten Böhmerwald erzählt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A plaque inside says the house was built in 1901 to honour the Czech nation. Above the third-floor windows, gold letters spell names like the composer Smetana and the poet Neruda. Much of the house began with gas lamps. But the inventor František Křižík made sure its Great Hall had electric light from the start. People who remembered the writer Karel Klostermann said he sat in the café here, telling stories of his beloved Šumava forest.

localizedStory.de: Schau unten am Haus des Bürgervereins nach zwei Nischen. Ein Bursche aus Pilsen tanzt mit seiner Liebsten, ein alter Dudelsackspieler spielt zum Tanz auf.
localizedStory.en: Look low on this burghers' hall for two niches. A Plzeň lad dances with his sweetheart, and an old bagpiper plays a dance tune.

fruits.name: Měšťanská beseda
fruits.story: Look low on this burghers' hall for two niches. A Plzeň lad dances with his sweetheart, and an old bagpiper plays a dance tune.

fruits.extendedStory: The tale says nobody knew why they sat in Old Plzeň's jail, and they were led here in chains. It is said they foretold the new town's fame among many nations, then vanished, chains and all. In 1950 the communist rulers shut the friars' home, like religious houses all over the country. When their rule ended, the Church got it back, and it now holds a museum of church art. The Franciscans came back in 1996, at the bishop's wish, but started out in a flat on a housing estate.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Der Überlieferung nach wusste niemand, warum die beiden in Alt-Pilsen im Gefängnis saßen, und man führte sie in Ketten hierher. Der Sage nach sagten sie voraus, die neue Stadt werde vielen Völkern bekannt sein, und verschwanden dann samt den Ketten. 1950 schlossen die kommunistischen Machthaber das Haus der Brüder, wie Ordenshäuser im ganzen Land. Als ihre Herrschaft endete, bekam die Kirche es zurück, und heute ist darin ein Museum für kirchliche Kunst. Die Franziskaner kamen 1996 auf Wunsch des Bischofs zurück, lebten aber zuerst in einer Wohnung in einer Wohnsiedlung.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The tale says nobody knew why they sat in Old Plzeň's jail, and they were led here in chains. It is said they foretold the new town's fame among many nations, then vanished, chains and all. In 1950 the communist rulers shut the friars' home, like religious houses all over the country. When their rule ended, the Church got it back, and it now holds a museum of church art. The Franciscans came back in 1996, at the bishop's wish, but started out in a flat on a housing estate.

localizedStory.de: Der Sage nach zeigten zwei rätselhafte Gefangene dem engen Alt-Pilsen den Platz für eine neue Stadt, bei einem Kirchlein im heutigen Kreuzgang.
localizedStory.en: The story goes that two mystery prisoners showed cramped Old Plzeň where to build anew, by a church now in this cloister.

fruits.name: Františkánský klášter
fruits.story: The story goes that two mystery prisoners showed cramped Old Plzeň where to build anew, by a church now in this cloister.

fruits.extendedStory: There were once two walls, and the main one had 28 bastions, strong points that jut out. The strip between them was mostly filled with the cottages of poor families. A short row still leans on the main wall, beside the water tower. From 1795 the moats were filled in, and the walls went with them, except where they were part of a house. Parks took their place.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Einst gab es zwei Mauern, und die Hauptmauer hatte 28 Basteien, vorspringende Bollwerke. Der Streifen zwischen ihnen war meist mit den Häuschen armer Familien gefüllt. Eine kurze Reihe lehnt noch an der Hauptmauer, neben dem Wasserturm. Ab 1795 wurden die Gräben zugeschüttet, und mit ihnen verschwanden die Mauern, außer wo sie Teil eines Hauses waren. An ihre Stelle traten Parks.
localizedExtendedStory.en: There were once two walls, and the main one had 28 bastions, strong points that jut out. The strip between them was mostly filled with the cottages of poor families. A short row still leans on the main wall, beside the water tower. From 1795 the moats were filled in, and the walls went with them, except where they were part of a house. Parks took their place.

localizedStory.de: Kaum eine tschechische Stadt hat ihre Mauern so schlecht erhalten wie Pilsen. Früh bebaute man den Mauerring. Hier steht ein Stück wie einst.
localizedStory.en: Few Czech town walls are as badly preserved as Plzeň's, because the town built on them early. Here in the park, one stretch survives unchanged.

fruits.name: hradební zeď
fruits.story: Few Czech town walls are as badly preserved as Plzeň's, because the town built on them early. Here in the park, one stretch survives unchanged.

fruits.extendedStory: The court began small, on the upper floors of the town hall, above the city's own offices. Both kept growing until the town hall ran out of room, so the court got a building of its own. It took the place of the old Dominican monastery, by then a military hospital. The plain new palace split opinion. Some well-known people in Plzeň disliked it for cutting into their historic town, while the architects of the day praised it.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Das Gericht fing klein an, in den oberen Stockwerken des Rathauses, über den Ämtern der Stadt. Beide wuchsen, bis das Rathaus zu eng wurde, und so bekam das Gericht ein eigenes Haus. Es trat an die Stelle des alten Dominikanerklosters, damals ein Militärkrankenhaus. Der nüchterne neue Justizpalast war umstritten. Manche bekannte Leute aus Pilsen fanden, er greife in ihre Altstadt ein, doch die Architekten jener Zeit lobten ihn.
localizedExtendedStory.en: The court began small, on the upper floors of the town hall, above the city's own offices. Both kept growing until the town hall ran out of room, so the court got a building of its own. It took the place of the old Dominican monastery, by then a military hospital. The plain new palace split opinion. Some well-known people in Plzeň disliked it for cutting into their historic town, while the architects of the day praised it.

localizedStory.de: Halte Ausschau nach der halbrunden Bastei. Hier auf dem Gelände des Gerichts steht noch ein Stück der alten Stadtmauer.
localizedStory.en: Look for the half-round bastion. A stretch of the city's old wall still survives right here, on the grounds of the court.

fruits.name: Krajský soud v Plzni
fruits.story: Look for the half-round bastion. A stretch of the city's old wall still survives right here, on the grounds of the court.

fruits.extendedStory: A shield full of horns of plenty, a sign of wealth, still recalls the bank. The library is older than the house: it began as a single cupboard of books, and moved in here decades later. Inside, the artist Jiří Kovařík painted two big pictures on the walls. The communist rulers branded him undesirable for standing up to them, so in the 1970s the paintings were covered up. Not until 2002 were they restored.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Ein Schild voller Füllhörner, ein Zeichen für Reichtum, erinnert noch an die Bank. Die Bibliothek ist älter als das Haus. Sie passte am Anfang in einen Schrank voller Bücher und zog erst Jahrzehnte später hier ein. Drinnen malte der Künstler Jiří Kovařík zwei große Wandbilder. Die kommunistischen Machthaber erklärten ihn für unerwünscht, weil er sich gegen sie stellte. Darum wurden die Bilder in den 1970er Jahren verdeckt und erst 2002 restauriert.
localizedExtendedStory.en: A shield full of horns of plenty, a sign of wealth, still recalls the bank. The library is older than the house: it began as a single cupboard of books, and moved in here decades later. Inside, the artist Jiří Kovařík painted two big pictures on the walls. The communist rulers branded him undesirable for standing up to them, so in the 1970s the paintings were covered up. Not until 2002 were they restored.

localizedStory.de: 1914 als Bank gebaut, ist das heute die Stadtbibliothek. Schau hinauf: Auf dem Gesims stehen zwei kleine Engel.
localizedStory.en: Built as a bank in 1914, this is now the city library. Look up to find two little angels standing on the cornice.

fruits.name: Knihovna města Plzně
fruits.story: Built as a bank in 1914, this is now the city library. Look up to find two little angels standing on the cornice.

fruits.extendedStory: No other house in Plzeň is known to have a Renaissance doorway like it. The house is named after Josef Gerlach, who taught music, dance and handwriting. For decades it was the heart of the city's musical life. By 1909 it was so run down that it was in danger of being torn down. Then the town bought it and gave it to the folk museum, which has had its exhibitions here since 1915.

localizedExtendedStory.de: Von keinem anderen Haus in Pilsen kennt man ein solches Renaissanceportal. Das Haus trägt den Namen von Josef Gerlach, der Musik, Tanz und Schönschrift unterrichtete. Jahrzehntelang war es das Herz des Musiklebens der Stadt. 1909 war es so verfallen, dass ihm der Abriss drohte. Dann kaufte die Stadt es und schenkte es dem Volkskundemuseum, das hier seit 1915 seine Ausstellungen zeigt.
localizedExtendedStory.en: No other house in Plzeň is known to have a Renaissance doorway like it. The house is named after Josef Gerlach, who taught music, dance and handwriting. For decades it was the heart of the city's musical life. By 1909 it was so run down that it was in danger of being torn down. Then the town bought it and gave it to the folk museum, which has had its exhibitions here since 1915.

localizedStory.de: Schau dir das Portal an. Zwei kleine Drachen halten eine haarige Fratze in den Klauen, die Pfeiler tragen Zeichen für Musik, Jagd und Krieg.
localizedStory.en: Look closely at the doorway. Two little dragons hold a hairy mask in their claws, and the pillars carry emblems of music, hunting and war.

fruits.name: Gerlachovský dům
fruits.story: Look closely at the doorway. Two little dragons hold a hairy mask in their claws, and the pillars carry emblems of music, hunting and war.
